title: Starting Seventh Grade
passage: I was nervous about starting seventh grade. I'm glad I have a new uniform, but I feel so short and weak compared to some of the other kids. The work was simple, though I assume it'll get harder. Week 2: I'm hanging out with another kid called Ray. He's a friendly guy who likes baseball too. He even takes the same bus as me, and the driver already knows us. Week 3: There's a strange boy in my social science class called Keith, who always copies my work. I try to cover it while he's looking, but it's annoying. I pray I can change seats soon. Week 4: I felt proud today because Mr. Johnson used my homework as an example to the class. Later, Mr. Johnson was angry with Keith for talking instead of listening to the English conversation. Then he moved Keith to another seat, which made me happy. Week 5: Both Ray and I like English. My elementary school friends thought English was boring, but this is cool because we can have lots of English conversations about baseball. I think we're going to have a good friendship.
